Refrigeration is the one appliance group the weather genuinely reaches: a fridge or freezer works against the air around it, so ambient heat raises the duty cycle and compressors run far longer in the hottest weeks.

Days over 90°F in {city}, {SS} total roughly {total}, concentrated in {peak}. A garage freezer has no air conditioning to help it — in those months it runs closer to continuously, which is why summer is when compressors and start relays give out.
